## Core Capabilities & Services
1. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) — https://sirisolutions.in/services/seo-services/
   Comprehensive organic search optimization, crawl architecture, search intent mapping, and authority building for competitive business sectors across India.
2. Local SEO Services — https://sirisolutions.in/services/local-seo/
   Google Business Profile optimization, local citation audit, review governance, and Google Maps local pack visibility.
3. Technical SEO Services — https://sirisolutions.in/services/technical-seo/
   Core Web Vitals remediation (LCP, INP, CLS), crawl budget optimization, canonical URL governance, and deep schema markup.
4. E-commerce SEO Services — https://sirisolutions.in/services/ecommerce-seo/
   Category hierarchy optimization, merchant listing schema, faceted navigation control, and Shopify / WooCommerce search growth.
5. SEO Audit Services — https://sirisolutions.in/services/seo-audit/
   Detailed forensic technical and competitive audits with actionable prioritized roadmaps delivered within 24 hours.
6. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — https://sirisolutions.in/services/geo-optimization/
   Structuring entity data, factual clarity, and digital PR citations for accurate discovery in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
7. Google Ads Management — https://sirisolutions.in/services/google-ads/
   Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaign architectures with Google Offline Conversion Tracking (GCLID) and high-intent negative keyword funnels.
8. PPC Management — https://sirisolutions.in/services/ppc-management/
   Full-funnel paid search and conversion rate optimization designed to reduce Cost Per Lead (CPL).
9. Meta Ads Management — https://sirisolutions.in/services/meta-ads/
   Paid Facebook & Instagram funnels integrated with Meta Server-Side Conversions API (CAPI) and Sell.Do / Zoho CRM workflows.
10. Social Media Marketing — https://sirisolutions.in/services/social-media-marketing/
    Brand storytelling, creative campaigns, and audience engagement across LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube.
11. Content Marketing — https://sirisolutions.in/services/content-marketing/
    Topical authority clusters, thought leadership, technical documentation, and high-ranking editorial assets.
12. Website Design — https://sirisolutions.in/services/website-design/
    Figma-crafted, clean, contemporary agency and corporate websites prioritizing whitespace, typography, and effortless usability.
13. Website Development — https://sirisolutions.in/services/website-development/
    Modern React, Next.js, and TypeScript web development delivering sub-2.0s Core Web Vitals on mobile 4G networks.
14. Landing Page Development — https://sirisolutions.in/services/landing-page-development/
    Focused campaign landing platforms and qualification funnels engineered to convert clicks into scheduled site visits and qualified RFQs.
15. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) — https://sirisolutions.in/services/conversion-rate-optimization/
    Heuristic evaluations, UX friction reduction, slide-out drawer funnels, and data-backed A/B split testing.
